lines.ro: Every client walks in saying: "I need an app."
lines.tts: [confident] Every client walks in saying... "I need an app."

lines.ro: Most of them don't. They need a spreadsheet that updates itself.
lines.tts: [matter-of-fact] Most of them don't. They need a spreadsheet that updates itself.

lines.ro: Three questions to tell. The third is where budgets die.
lines.tts: [serious] Three questions to tell. The third is where budgets die.

lines.ro: One: who uses it? Customers, maybe an app. Only your team? You need an internal tool, not an App Store listing.
lines.tts: One: who uses it? Customers, maybe an app. Only your team? You need an internal tool, not an App Store listing.

lines.ro: Two: does the same job happen every day? Copying orders, pulling reports, updating stock. If it repeats, automate it.
lines.tts: [clear] Two. Does the same job happen every day? Copying orders, pulling reports, updating stock. If it repeats, automate it.

lines.ro: Three: can you draw the whole thing on one page? If not, don't build yet. That's the step people skip, and where budgets explode.
lines.tts: Three: can you draw the whole thing on one page? If not, don't build yet. That's the step people skip... and where budgets explode.

lines.ro: We scope every project on one page before writing a line of code. Comment SCOPE and I'll send you our checklist.
lines.tts: [warm] We scope every project on one page before writing a line of code. Comment scope, and I'll send you our checklist.
